title: Cyclic Fueter Theory: Lean 4 Formalization of Selected Results
description:
This software repository contains Lean 4 source files developed in connection with the Cyclic Fueter Theory (CFT) research program. It formalizes selected algebraic and geometric statements involving quaternionic algebra, Fueter-type operators, matrix and spinor constructions, quantum-geometric identities, Cartan-frame calculations, the reduced Einstein–Yang–Mills action and its four-dimensional field equations, distributional junction conditions, characteristic evolution and constraint propagation, zero-mode calculations, and consequences of the action principle for the Einstein–Yang–Mills dumbbell (caps as closed radiation universes, the AdS₂ × S² neck, JT/Schwarzian reduction, thermodynamics, and stability).

Version 0.5.0 contains 1641 theorem declarations in 150 modules, with no sorry and no project-specific axioms, plus 340 index aliases. New in this version: bridges between the cap and the neck (a common Gaussian clock in which the cap's crunch and the neck's focal time are distinct events; W = r′ as a twist cancelling spin connection and gauge field, with zero modes localised on the caps; the geometry of the neck temperature); a root review of the cap–neck junction (C¹ but not C²: curvature, density and radial pressure jump, and the Hamiltonian constraint admits exactly two values of r″) and of the duality between the quantum hemisphere and the relativistic hyperboloid (the hemisphere model of H³); a new pillar based on the polar decomposition SL(2,ℂ) = rotation × boost and the self-dual connection; a conformal frame in which cap and neck are conformal multiples of the Einstein static universe solving □Ω = Ω, with a minisuperspace of period 2π and a semiclassical candidate ℓ²/ℓ_P² = 4(n + ½)/(3π) (classified as partial); and a smoothness map of static Einstein–Yang–Mills(+Λ) geometries (no static throat, the family of cylindrical necks up to the ultracold limit, the Einstein static universe with Yang–Mills field, a Breitenlohner–Freedman violation in the AdS₂ throat, and numerical reproduction of the closed cigar-shaped cosmological Bartnik–McKinnon analogues, cited from the literature). An independent audit by a second agent checked every addition since v0.4.0; its findings (three index aliases redirected by a name collision, one inconsistent ledger item, scope and wording) were corrected. The repository includes an author-maintained status ledger of 134 items in α-I–α-XIV (62 complete, 46 complete using a named external theorem or literature, 9 complete in a differential field pending a bridge to real functions, 10 partial, 7 not started). These labels describe the current scope of this formalization; they are not independent certification or peer review of the corresponding research claims. Numerical results quoted in the ledger are not verified by Lean. Lean verifies each theorem from its declared assumptions and imported results. Formalization does not by itself establish that a physical model, external theorem, or interpretation is appropriate.

The project targets Lean 4.15.0 and Mathlib v4.15.0. To reproduce the build, install Elan and run `lake update`, `lake exe cache get`, and `lake build` from the repository root.
